reviews.title: Are you a man with a maid fetish? No? Too bad
reviews.text: This game pretends for fifteen minutes that a woman, like myself, might enjoy playing a game that lets you choose your preferences. This game pretends, but at a baseline your character is a man (“they/them” dialogue pronouns are spotty and your character is physically described as a man with a six pack, muscular arms, and moles on his pelvis….. ok thanks) with an INTENSE maid fetish. Don’t find maids sexy? There is literally no option for that. Into some Nikes and not others? The game assumes you are open-mouth salivating over every single one (especially in a maid costume). Plot is fine, mechanics are fine. But wow, the subservience fetish is aggressive in a game about women forced to battle after violent deaths.

reviews.title: It’s alright, just a problem
reviews.text:
My problem with it has two different reasons.
One: It takes forever to do anything, it takes around 15 seconds for me to level up someone because it’s loading without telling me, so I don’t know if it’s still loading or crashed.
Two: I hate how those world things and characters aren’t separate, considering I have possibly around 50 or so of those small world things and only 8 characters, fun characters? Kind of, I like the big dudes and cool girls, but that’s it. 
Overall, aside from the sonic thing you did, it’s just fine, not the best game I’ve ever played, but I can actually see myself playing it because you let me control my characters manually so I can dodge attacks for them or wait out the clock on my moves.
In the end, I give it a three out of five

reviews.title: Fair, caring, and enjoyable
reviews.text: So I’ve been playing this game back when it first came out and seen the many changes it’s been through. The Dev of last Cloudia are kind, in a way which I mean they care about their players. Few key factor of this is the gacha cost and how easy and often they help you get crystals for them if your gacha type person. second is the story, it’s very emmersive and extremely enjoyable to watch and read the cutscenes as well as the fact of a hidden manga series you can obtain doing side stuff that is completely readable in the game that is help you understand story more if your story/lore type (which I am). And finally the combat system, you can choose to idle or fight with full control. The combat amazing to how you can move your character and set up how you like and the ally AI system is by far amazing as it actually act like if a play was using it and the healers are god tier with the instant reaction for healing and buffs. Overall this game is extremely worth playing with half yearly anniversaries, many events, re-run event that add new characters each time and give you items to get free older version hero you like.  Now my only complaint thus far is the gacha as the rate of gold is far too high and for a lot vets like myself the crimson ore rewards just aren’t fully cutting it, and I’m sure there was a good reason for changing the gacha scene you used to do showing memories from into just showing a hero icon image but please make that optional in the setting is  least I could ask and maybe up the red rates more.  Well this was my experience in this far and I look forward to what it has in the future, Thank you Dev for all your hard work you put in LAST CLOUDIA
